szoveg_eredeti:
Teaching robots new tasks just got a lot faster. 🤖

With Gemini 4 Hydrogen and the new robotics plugin for Google @Antigravity, you can connect a supported arm, practice in @MuJoCo simulation, and run tasks in the real world using plain conversation.
